channel.title: Game news | CTRL+A GAME
channel.description: Verified gaming news from every platform: launches, free games, deals and updates. Every story links to its official source.

item.title: Game Pass adds The Outlast Trials, Hela and Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2
item.description: Ten new titles arrive, and eight leave on November 30.

item.title: The Game Awards 2026 nominees: the Switch games
item.description: Nintendo congratulated the nominees and listed those playable on Switch 2 and Switch.

item.title: ROB RUN patch adds profanity filter and fixes
item.description: Jail Time limits, voice chat and connection fixes

item.title: Planet Zoo 2 is nominated at The Game Awards
item.description: Nominated for Best Sim/Strategy game.

item.title: MLB The Show 27 is bringing back its Tech Test
item.description: Details are coming in the new year, alongside the return of Now & Later Packs.

item.title: Melvor Idle 2 launches in Steam Early Access
item.description: Three new skills, 121 enemies and Act 2 quests are in.

item.title: Limbus Company: Project Moon's 10th anniversary gift
item.description: Log in during the claim period to get 1300 Lunacy and a 3★ Guaranteed Decaextraction Ticket.

item.title: Hounded comes to PS5 in 2027
item.description: Duke the Border Collie leads a search for his missing master.

item.title: When does GTA VI open? Local midnight in your country, plus pre-load and prep
item.description: GTA VI unlocks at local midnight on November 19 in every region; pre-loading is already open.

item.title: When is GTA VI online coming? What Rockstar has said and not said
item.description: Rockstar and Take-Two have made no official announcement about an online mode, and no date has been given.

item.title: Knockout expansion is out
item.description: Brawler gets 11 new weapons, a new biome and Hazard 6.

item.title: Crusader Kings III: Silk & Silver is out now
item.description: Merchant and Republic governments arrive, with two new bookmarks and a free 1.21 update.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time is now playable on Switch 2
item.description: Nintendo says the game is available now, exclusively on Switch 2.

item.title: Xbox Black Friday sale starts November 19
item.description: Up to 80% off select Xbox and PC games, US only.

item.title: Pokémon Pokopia's Apples to Applin event runs until December 1
item.description: An apple-themed event brings Applin and its evolutions to Pokémon Pokopia towns on Switch 2.

item.title: Just Volleyball is out now with a launch discount
item.description: 38% off on Steam for about 8 days.

item.title: Football Manager 27 update 27.1.0 is set to roll out this week
item.description: The update brings crash fixes, faster loading on lower-end PCs and Match Engine tweaks.

item.title: DREADMOOR Early Access Update 7 is live with save and quest fixes
item.description: Fixes for save loading, quest progression, fishing and boat controls.

item.title: Borderlands community breaks The Hunt donation record
item.description: The fundraiser passed the previous record and the matching goal for St. Jude.

item.title: Borderlands 4 community beats 6.2 million bosses, unlocks four skins
item.description: Four weapon skins are unlocked as a community reward, redeemable with a SHiFT code until December 31, 2030.

item.title: Xbox's 25th anniversary magazine is now open to everyone
item.description: Xbox's 25th anniversary special magazine is live on Xbox Wire and readable by anyone.

item.title: Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Vital Signal lands December 1 and splits Ranked in two
item.description: Ubisoft has revealed Year 11 Season 4: a Doc remaster, separate Solo/Duo and Flex ranked playlists, and the new MBZ-19 SMG.

item.title: Delta Force explains Brakkesh 2.0 faction jobs and new combat routes
item.description: The developer post details persistent badge progress, control-room routes and rival squad hunts.

item.title: Slay the Spire 2 beta hotfix fixes a Turkish Timeline freeze
item.description: Beta v0.113.1 addresses Turkish Fool progression and duplicate entries in Run History.

item.title: LoL New Dawn gets a teaser: full reveal in January, release later in 2027
item.description: Riot's official schedule separates the detailed presentation from the eventual release.

item.title: WoW: Forever hotfixes: Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza and an Action Bar fix
item.description: Blizzard's November 13, 2026 hotfix list covers the weekly fishing tournament and an Action Bar bug.

item.title: Blizzard publishes the WoW: Forever short story "Cost of Honor"
item.description: The official WoW site now lets you watch the WoW: Forever short story "Cost of Honor".

item.title: Selaco Chapter 2: The Machines of War is out with 19 new maps
item.description: The Early Access shooter's biggest update adds a 6–8 hour campaign, but old saves will not carry over.

item.title: PS5 QSSR: Spider-Man 2 update is live, with more games to follow
item.description: PlayStation confirms separate rollout windows for the next QSSR game updates.

item.title: Path of Exile: Covens of Umbra is live on PC and console
item.description: Grinding Gear Games' new expansion went live on November 13; there is a workaround for a waypoint crash on the Russian language setting.
